answer: Require each agent to pass one verified inlet: a hardware-backed identity check plus a refundable stake that is slashed if a duplicate identity appears. One person can pass the inlet only once, so spinning up thousands of fake agents means paying thousands of stakes and risking forfeiture on every one. Honest agents keep their stake and build reputation over a long horizon, while sybil farms face rising costs and find no oasis of free identities to exploit.
